protocol.pairing: identical wave-realization, IMU-noise, and initialization seeds
protocol.sensitivity_design: one factor at a time around one frozen nominal OU-III point
protocol.transition_method: C2 quintic blend with exact first- and second-derivative cross terms
protocol.wave_phase_method: common random phase on the 0.02-1.60 Hz world-velocity and Euler spectra; displacement and acceleration analytically derived from velocity; body IMU and quaternion reconstructed
